14.10.title: Comparison of Radio Link and Wired Link Transmit Power
14.10.title_cn: 无线电链路与有线链路发射功率比较
14.10.description: A cellular base station is to be connected to its Mobile Telephone Switching Office located 5 km away. Two possibilities are to be evaluated: (1) a radio link operating at 28 GHz, with $G_t = G_r = 25$ dB, and (2) a wired link using coaxial line having an attenuation of 0.05 dB/m, with four 30 dB repeater amplifiers along the line. If the minimum required received power level for both cases is the same, which option will require the smallest transmit power?
14.10.description_cn: 一个蜂窝基站需要连接到位于 5 km 外的移动电话交换局。需要评估两种方案：(1) 工作频率为 28 GHz 的无线电链路，发射和接收天线增益均为 25 dB；(2) 使用同轴电缆的有线链路，同轴电缆衰减为 0.05 dB/m，沿线设有四个 30 dB 的中继放大器。如果两种情况所需的最小接收功率水平相同，哪种方案需要的发射功率最小？

distance.description: Distance between base station and switching office

steps.title: Radio Link: Path Loss Calculation
steps.title_cn: 无线电链路：路径损耗计算
steps.explanation: Free-space path loss formula (Friis equation in dB)
steps.explanation_cn: 自由空间路径损耗公式（弗里斯传输公式的 dB 形式）

steps.title: Radio Link: Transmit Power Requirement
steps.title_cn: 无线电链路：发射功率需求
steps.formula: $P_{r,\text{dBm}} = P_{t,\text{dBm}} + G_{t,\text{dB}} + G_{r,\text{dB}} - L_{\text{path,dB}}$ \\ $P_{t,\text{radio,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} - G_{t,\text{dB}} - G_{r,\text{dB}} + L_{\text{path,dB}}$ \\ $P_{t,\text{radio,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} - 50 + 135.36 = P_{r,\text{dBm}} + 85.36 \text{ dB}$
steps.formula_cn: $P_{r,\text{dBm}} = P_{t,\text{dBm}} + G_{t,\text{dB}} + G_{r,\text{dB}} - L_{\text{path,dB}}$ \\ $P_{t,\text{radio,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} - G_{t,\text{dB}} - G_{r,\text{dB}} + L_{\text{path,dB}}$ \\ $P_{t,\text{radio,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} - 50 + 135.36 = P_{r,\text{dBm}} + 85.36 \text{ dB}$
steps.explanation: Link budget in dB, antenna gains total 50 dB
steps.explanation_cn: dB 形式的链路预算，天线增益合计 50 dB

steps.title: Wired Link: Cable and Amplifier Net Loss
steps.title_cn: 有线链路：电缆与放大器净损耗
steps.explanation: Total cable attenuation minus total amplifier gain
steps.explanation_cn: 电缆总衰减减去放大器总增益

steps.title: Wired Link: Transmit Power Requirement
steps.title_cn: 有线链路：发射功率需求
steps.explanation: Link budget for wired link (no antennas, just cable and amplifiers)
steps.explanation_cn: 有线链路链路预算（无天线，仅电缆和放大器）

steps.title: Comparison and Conclusion
steps.formula: $P_{t,\text{radio,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} + 85.36 \text{ dB}$ \\ $P_{t,\text{wired,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} + 130 \text{ dB}$ \\ $\Delta = 130 - 85.36 = 44.64 \text{ dB}$ \\ $\text{Radio link requires } 44.64 \text{ dB less transmit power}$
steps.formula_cn: $P_{t,\text{radio,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} + 85.36 \text{ dB}$ \\ $P_{t,\text{wired,dBm}} = P_{r,\text{dBm}} + 130 \text{ dB}$ \\ $\Delta = 130 - 85.36 = 44.64 \text{ dB}$ \\ $\text{无线电链路发射功率小 } 44.64 \text{ dB}$
steps.explanation: Compare required transmit power for same received power level
steps.explanation_cn: 在相同接收功率水平下比较所需发射功率

14.10.conclusion: The radio link (Option 1) requires significantly smaller transmit power (44.64 dB less) than the wired link.
14.10.conclusion_cn: 无线电链路（方案1）需要的发射功率远小于有线链路（小 44.64 dB）。
